reviewer: Kimi main recovery executor actually viewed the exact source and NEAREST 8x detail, complete unchanged current raw, full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa reference; compared pose, note groups, cap, uniform and backing, and verified evidence/source/output/task/prompt/request/result/sheet bindings with read-only Python.

remaining_reasons: The source faces viewer right toward the note, with the larger near eye on viewer left and mouth/nose mass on the right. External-05 still has the larger near eye on viewer right and mouth mass on the left. Restore the source's viewer-right pose and gaze rather than repeating the reversed orientation.

The source has TWO separated irregular gray-mark groups in its upper note row and TWO separated irregular gray-mark groups in its lower row. External-05 instead shows four repeated blobs in the upper row and three in the lower row. Restore exactly TWO source-scale separated irregular groups in EACH row with the original relative lengths and compact footprint, not repeated generic dots or invented writing. Keep the blank lower paper and small right-edge tab.

hair_features.reason: Dark brows and a clean-shaven face remain, with cap-covered hair and no glasses or beard added.

collar_fit.reason: The red standing collar fits a short broad neck without pinching, floating cloth or a cream bib.

entries.positive_observation: The yellow mascot has green-ringed black eyes, dark brows and one closed mouth. The olive peaked cap retains gold eagle, wreath/cockade, braid/piping and glossy visor; the dark tunic and red gold-embroidered collar tabs remain. The frame/backplate, small dark right-edge tab and blank lower note remain, with genuine exterior transparency and no visible interior holes on white/cyan.
entries.alpha_decision: The native RGBA and white/cyan comparisons show genuine exterior transparency without visible interior holes or working-matte halo. Near-opacity is not itself a rejection ground, but the reversed pose and four-plus-three repeated blobs replacing two-plus-two source groups are visible RGB defects, so this is not approved for production.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine cap/collar motifs and note glyph identities cannot be transcribed at 65x67. Rejection is for the clearly reversed orientation and changed gray-mark group count, not guessed writing or microscopic embroidery.
